name: Houjou Chieri
source:
The rich aloof ojousama classmate who likes to do scenic paintings. She seems to like to play on words (in particular using different kanjis than usual). Usually a gentle and refined girl, but can often speak coldly and cynically with others. You'll find out that the jealousy is strong with this one…

[Edited from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/03/09/hello-world-review/]review[/url] by Warum]
